svg.text: The relay may crash after sending but before deleting: the message is sent twice
an idempotency key lets the destination de-duplicate (chapter 5.7)
Eventual consistency is fine here; no 2PC needed (the search service has no XA support, and we must not block on it)
Conceptually like state machine replication: the outbox table is the log of operations (Debezium is an open source relay)
